examples.text: Ci sono diecimila studenti in questa università.
examples.en: There are ten thousand students in this university.

examples.text: Risparmiò non meno di diecimila dollari.
examples.en: He saved no less than ten thousand dollars.

examples.text: Voglio cambiare diecimila yen in dollari.
examples.en: I want to change ten thousand yen to dollars.

examples.text: Metto in banca diecimila yen ogni mese.
examples.en: I put ten thousand yen into the bank every month.
